patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections and large background imagery are used extensively, often with dark overlays to ensure text readability.
Major content sections are visually separated by massive, semi-transparent, full-width words that act as scroll-triggered dividers.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for sections and smaller, legible sans-serif for body text and labels.
A high-contrast color scheme is employed, primarily using deep darks, bright whites, and a vibrant blue for accents and calls to action.
The navigation bar transforms from a transparent, minimal state to a dark, opaque bar with additional links after scrolling past the hero section.
Background images in hero sections exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: The sticky header dynamically changes its background color, content (adding navigation links), and height after a certain scroll threshold, providing a clear visual cue of page depth.
Hero sections utilize a parallax scrolling effect where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth and visual interest.

Large, semi-transparent text elements are revealed and animated into view as the user scrolls, acting as prominent visual anchors and transitions between major content blocks, likely using scroll-triggered animation libraries.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin hero text transitions to bold, prominent section headings (~3x body) with clear, readable body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, cards, and input fields feature a slight, consistent border-radius).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between sections, comfortable padding within content blocks, and well-distributed elements in grids.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the use of massive, semi-transparent, full-width words ('PURIFY', 'INFUSE', 'ENJOY', 'SUSTAINABILITY') that appear and fade as scroll-triggered section dividers. This creates a strong, unique visual rhythm and narrative flow, making the page feel dynamic and engaging beyond typical section transitions.
